Anna (Partnerships): FYI — AcmeNet wants a bundled marketplace listing that includes their accelerator HW + our hosted model offering. They want a coordinated co-announcement and a single marketplace SKU. Can Legal and Product eyeball redistribution/licensing implications?
Kevin (Legal): Quick Q — are they asking us to redistribute model weights or to host behind our API with a bundled purchase? Big diff for license.
Anna (Partnerships): They said both options are on table: (1) Hosted + gp-tier access via marketplace; (2) Redistribution of quantized weights to partner for edge SKUs. We need to confirm allowed by upstream model license.
Sam (Product): If redistribution is allowed we need explicit pinning/versioning in the contract + artifact hashes. Otherwise we only do hosted variant. Also need to define rollout/fallback policies if partner capacity drops.
Marie (Eng-ML): On redistribution: quantization will produce derived weights. Some licenses forbid "derivative" distribution. Also need to ensure we can reproduce quantization steps — include quantization recipe in the SOW?
Kevin (Legal): Agree. Ask: which upstream model? We need the exact model name + license URL. If it's Apache-2 / MIT we're fine generally. AGPL or certain custom non-commercial licenses are blockers.
Anna (Partnerships): Model is called "OpenHorizon-13B" (linked repo: https://models.example/openhorizon-13b). License file attached in their repo.
Kevin (Legal): Reviewing — this one is a dual-license: permissive for use, but redistribution requires attribution + repo link + no sublicensing. Draft clause suggestion below.
Kevin (Legal): ```
Permitted redistribution (partner-distributed artifacts): Partner may redistribute quantized or finetuned artifacts derived from OpenHorizon-13B only if:
1) Upstream license is preserved and a copy of original LICENSE is included;
2) A clear attribution line is present;
3) No additional sublicensing or proprietary re-licensing is asserted;
4) Redwood retains right to revoke redistribution on evidence of license violation.
```
Priya (Marketing): Important: if redistribution is allowed we must coordinate embargo windows. Partner needs 72h pre-announce clearance to scrub messaging. Suggest timeline: internal review -> partner review -> press embargo (T-3 days) -> publish. Thoughts? :calendar: :megaphone:
Amanda (Partner Ops): Partner asked for co-announcement on 2025-11-17. They want a marketplace listing live same day. That gives ~6 weeks. Need legal + badge/asset collection in 2 weeks.
Jonah (Sales): For marketplace SKU: we need to decide packaging: (A) Hosted-only subscription SKU, (B) Edge SKU (one-time installer + HW bundle). Pricing & revenue share TBD. Also need marketing assets for marketplace tile (short description + 3 bullets).
Sam (Product): Tech notes: Hosted SKU must include model version pin + fallback to a smaller variant (e.g., OpenHorizon-7B) if quotas exceeded. Add a route config: `model_spec: openhorizon-13b@v1`; `fallback: openhorizon-7b@v2`.
Marie (Eng-ML): Also include quantization profile & seed in SOW so partner's redistributed artifacts match our served outputs. Small diffs in ops can create drift. Recommend we add `quantize_recipe_v2.sha256` to manifest.
Kevin (Legal): I'm OK with the draft redistribution clause but need to add export-control warranty language. If partner intends to ship to APAC, confirm destination countries. Also include indemnity carveouts.
Priya (Marketing): For co-announcement creative — partner wants logo lockups. Can partners provide logos + trademark usage guidelines by EOD next Thursday? We need high-res + 2-line partner quote.
Anna (Partnerships): @Kevin can you produce redline clause by EOD Friday? @Priya I can chase assets with partner tomorrow. @Marie can you prepare short quantization manifest example?
Kevin (Legal): On it — will push redline to shared drive and ping for review.
Marie (Eng-ML): I'll drop a manifest snippet in the drive and include minimal verification script. Example manifest snippet: ```
{
  "model": "openhorizon-13b",
  "quantize_recipe": "qv2-8bit.sq",
  "recipe_sha256": "3a7f...b1c9"
}```
Amanda (Partner Ops): Calendar-bot, please create a 30-min sync next Tuesday 14:00 PT and invite partner reps + legal + product + marketing.
calendar-bot: Event created: "AcmeNet x Redwood marketplace co-announcement sync" — Tue 2025-10-21 14:00 PT. Guests: Anna, Kevin, Sam, Marie, Priya, Jonah, Amanda, AcmeNet PM.
Jonah (Sales): Quick ask — can we get an approved partner pricing band before the sync? Need floor/ceiling to model commission.
Anna (Partnerships): I'll request pricing band from AcmeNet and attach to the drive. If legal flags redistribution as blocked we pivot to hosted-only co-marketing. :+1:
Priya (Marketing): Noted — if hosted-only we still do a joint marketplace tile + customer case highlight. Draft timeline still stands.
Kevin (Legal): Final note — don't let partner host third-party forks of the model under a different name without express permission. We'll include a naming clause.
Anna (Partnerships): Thanks all — will aggregate tasks into the shared checklist and ping for signoffs. :rocket:
